events.local_64.5: ≥ 64.5 mm somewhere in the state (any grid cell)

interval.method: adaptive conformal (each tail targets 10%; levels update daily from verified misses, 45-day score buffer)

notes: Rows for already-verified dates are in-sample fits (the post-processor was trained on them); the honest scores are in runtime/hydra_v3_1_evaluation_imd.json.
Amounts are expected values and still under-state rare peaks; use the probabilities and alert tiers for heavy rain.
state_64.5 has very few training events; treat its probabilities as indicative only.
